bounty_mutiny.description: A small group of founders, inspired by the HMS Bounty mutiny. This scenario starts with 15 young men and 12 young women, all in their reproductive prime.

aging_village.description: An aging population of Gorillas. Can the one young couple and the elderly village survive.

kids.description: Inspired by TV shows where only the kids survive. The population consists of 100 prepubescent children.

genophage.description: Inspired by Mass Effect. A population of 150 Neanderthals is struck by a plague causing 80% sterility. The remaining fertile individuals must rebuild. Ages are randomized.

generation_ship.description: A starship is traveling to another solar system. And the people want to quickly multiply before they touch down. It consists of 30 males of one species and 30 females of another species. Everyone is of a nubile age.

survival_of_the_fittest.description: A test of endurance. One male and one female of every species, all starting at puberty age. Who will pass natural selection?

vault_69.description: Inspired by Fallout. Vault 69 has 10 males and 100 females, all at puberty. Vault 69 consists entirely of orcs. In Vault 69, 10% of females are infertile, but all males are fertile.

vault_68.description: Inspired by Fallout. Vault 68 has 10 females and 100 males, all at puberty. Vault 68 consists entirely of elves. In Vault 68, 10% of males are infertile, but all females are fertile.
